title: Britpop, a British accent
style: English, British accent, male vocal, britpop, jangly electric guitars, tambourine, anthemic, 118 bpm
lyrics:
[Intro]

[Verse]
Rain on the windows of the Northern line,
Cup of tea and a borrowed time,
We were kings of a corner shop,
Singing loud till the music stopped.

[Chorus]
And we'll be alright, alright tonight,
Underneath the orange streetlight,
Raise your hands up to the sky,
We're too young to say goodbye.

[Verse]
Mum keeps asking when I'll settle down,
I've got a guitar and the whole of town,
Every pub's a stage and every night's a show,
We'll be somebody someday, I just know.

[Chorus]
And we'll be alright, alright tonight,
Underneath the orange streetlight,
Raise your hands up to the sky,
We're too young to say goodbye.

[Outro]
